question: How long does delivery take?

question: Do you deliver to all cities?

question: What payment methods do you accept?

question: Can I pay with UPI?

question: Is cash on delivery available?

question: Is it safe to pay online?
answer: Yes, all online payments are encrypted and processed through secure payment gateways. We never store your card details.

question: What is your return policy?

question: Do you offer refunds?

question: Can I get my money back?

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item, click Return, and choose a pickup time. Our courier will collect it from your address.

question: How do I send an item back?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item, click Return, and choose a pickup time. Our courier will collect it from your address.

question: I want to send something back
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item, click Return, and choose a pickup time. Our courier will collect it from your address.

question: What if I received a damaged or wrong item?
answer: Please report it within 48 hours from My Orders with a photo. We will send a replacement or give a full refund.

question: Can I exchange a product for a different size?
answer: Yes, exchanges for size or color are available within 7 days of delivery, subject to stock.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up at the top of the page, enter your name, email, and phone number, and verify with the OTP we send you.

question: How can I reset my password?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page and enter your email. We will send you a link to set a new password.

question: Do you have any discount coupons?
answer: Yes, check the Offers page for current coupons. Enter the code at checkout to apply the discount.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Email support@shopeasy.example or call 1800-123-456, Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM.

question: What are your customer care timings?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM.

question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
answer: You can change the address from My Orders before the order is shipped. After shipping, please contact support.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes, the ShopEasy app is available on the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store.

question: I did not receive an order confirmation
answer: Check your spam folder first. You can also see all confirmed orders under My Orders. If it is missing there, contact support.

question: Why is my order delayed?
answer: Delays can happen due to weather, high demand, or courier issues. Check Track Order for the latest status, or contact support if it is more than 2 days late.

question: My order has not arrived yet
answer: Check Track Order for the latest status. If it is more than 2 days past the delivery date, contact support with your order ID.

question: How can I see my past orders?
answer: Log in and open My Orders to see your full order history, invoices, and delivery status.

question: Can I add more items to an order I already placed?
answer: No, orders cannot be modified after placing. You can cancel the order before shipping and place a new one, or order the extra items separately.

question: Can I change the items in my order?
answer: No, items cannot be changed after the order is placed. Cancel it before it ships and place a new order.

question: Money was deducted but my order was not placed
answer: If payment failed but money was deducted, it is automatically refunded within 5 to 7 working days. Contact support if you do not receive it.

question: My payment failed
answer: Please check your card or UPI details and balance, then try again. If the problem continues, try a different payment method.

question: Do you offer EMI?
answer: Yes, EMI is available on select credit cards for orders above Rs 3,000. You can see the options at checkout.

question: Can I buy a gift card?
answer: Yes, ShopEasy gift cards are available in values from Rs 500 to Rs 10,000 and are delivered by email.

question: Can I send an order as a gift?
answer: Yes, enter your friend's address at checkout and tick the Gift Wrap option. The price will not appear on the package.

question: How do I download my invoice?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the order, and click Download Invoice. It is also sent to your email after delivery.

question: Can I get a GST bill?
answer: Yes, enter your GST number at checkout to get a GST invoice for your order.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: No, we currently deliver only within India.

question: Do you offer same day delivery?
answer: Same day delivery is available in select cities for orders placed before 12 noon. Check availability at checkout.

question: What if I am not home when the courier comes?
answer: The courier will try delivery up to 3 times. You can also reschedule the delivery from the Track Order page.

question: Can I reschedule my delivery?
answer: Yes, open Track Order and choose Reschedule Delivery to pick a new date, up to 3 days ahead.

question: What if an item is out of stock?
answer: Click Notify Me on the product page and we will email you when it is back in stock.

question: Are your products original?
answer: Yes, all products are 100 percent genuine and sourced directly from brands or authorized sellers.

question: Do products come with a warranty?
answer: Yes, electronics and appliances come with the manufacturer warranty. The warranty details are on the product page.

question: Is there a minimum order value?
answer: There is no minimum order value. However, shipping is free only on orders above Rs 499.

question: Can I use more than one coupon?
answer: Only one coupon can be applied per order. Choose the one that gives you the biggest discount.

question: Why was my order cancelled?
answer: Orders can be cancelled due to payment failure, an out-of-stock item, or an undeliverable address. A refund is issued automatically if you already paid.

question: How do I check my refund status?
answer: Open My Orders, select the returned order, and click Refund Status. Refunds take 5 to 7 working days after pickup.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5 to 7 working days after we receive the returned item.

question: I missed the return window, can I still return?
answer: Returns are accepted only within 7 days of delivery. After that, please contact support and we will try to help.

question: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
answer: No, return pickup is free for damaged, wrong, or defective items. For other returns, a small pickup fee of Rs 40 may apply.

question: How do I change my phone number or email?
answer: Go to My Account, then Profile Settings, and update your details. You will need to verify with an OTP.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Email support@shopeasy.example from your registered email address and we will delete your account within 7 days.

question: Can I order without creating an account?
answer: Yes, you can check out as a guest using your email and phone number, but creating an account lets you track orders easily.

question: Do you accept bulk orders?
answer: Yes, for orders of 20 or more items, email bulk@shopeasy.example for special pricing.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the order, click Cancel Order, choose a reason, and confirm. Cancellation is possible only before the item is shipped.

question: I want to cancel my order
answer: Go to My Orders, select the order, click Cancel Order, choose a reason, and confirm. Cancellation is possible only before the item is shipped.

question: Can I cancel after the order is shipped?
answer: No, shipped orders cannot be cancelled. You can refuse the delivery at your door or return the item within 7 days of receiving it.

question: Is there a cancellation fee?
answer: No, there is no fee for cancelling an order before it ships.

question: When will I get my money after cancelling an order?
answer: Refunds for cancelled orders go to your original payment method within 3 to 5 working days. For cash on delivery orders, nothing is charged.

question: Can I cancel only one item from my order?
answer: Yes, open My Orders, select the item, and click Cancel Item before it ships. The other items in the order are not affected.

question: Can I cancel a cash on delivery order?
answer: Yes, cash on delivery orders can be cancelled from My Orders before shipping, with no charge.

question: The cancel button is not showing
answer: The Cancel option disappears once an order is shipped. If your order has not shipped and you still cannot see it, contact support with your order ID.

question: I cancelled my order by mistake, can I undo it?
answer: Cancelled orders cannot be restored. Please place a new order. If the item is in stock, you can order it again right away.

question: What happens to my coupon if I cancel the order?
answer: If the coupon has not expired, it is added back to your account within 24 hours of cancellation.

question: Can I refuse the delivery at my door?
answer: Yes, you can refuse the package when the courier arrives. The order is marked as returned and your refund is processed after the item reaches us.

question: How do I cancel a return or exchange request?
answer: Go to My Orders, open the return request, and click Cancel Return before the pickup is done.

question: I ordered the wrong item, what should I do?
answer: If the order has not shipped, cancel it from My Orders and place a new one. If it has shipped, you can return it within 7 days.

question: How do I write a review for a product?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the delivered item, click Write a Review, give a star rating, add your comments, and submit.

question: How do I rate a product?
answer: Open My Orders, choose the delivered item, and tap the stars under Rate this Product. You can add a written review too.

question: Can I review a product I did not buy?
answer: No, only customers who have bought and received a product can review it. This keeps the reviews genuine.

question: Can I edit or delete my review?
answer: Yes, go to My Account, then My Reviews, and click Edit or Delete next to the review.

question: Why is my review not showing?
answer: Reviews are checked before publishing, which takes up to 48 hours. Reviews that break our guidelines are not published.

question: How long does it take for my review to appear?
answer: Most reviews appear within 48 hours after they are submitted and approved.

question: Can I add photos to my review?
answer: Yes, you can upload up to 5 photos with your review when you click Write a Review.

question: How do I rate the delivery or the seller?
answer: After delivery, we email you a short feedback form. You can also rate the delivery from the order details page in My Orders.

question: Are the reviews on your site genuine?
answer: Yes, products show a Verified Purchase tag when the review comes from a customer who actually bought the item.

question: How do I report a fake or abusive review?
answer: Click Report under the review, choose a reason, and submit. Our team will check it within 3 working days.

question: Can I review a product after returning it?
answer: Yes, you can still review a returned product within 30 days of delivery, as long as you mention that it was returned.

question: Do I get rewards for writing reviews?
answer: Yes, you earn 10 ShopEasy points for each review and 25 points if it includes a photo. Points can be used at checkout.
